Railway RRB Paramedical CEN 05/2026 Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Short Notice for the post of Paramedical Staff Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment has released for 560 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 will Start from 15 September 2026, & candidate can apply untill 14 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 14 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Important Links

  • Official Website
